description: Verify that DUT's ICMP Timestamp Reply echoes the Identifier and Sequence Number fields verbatim from the matching Timestamp Request — analogous to the Echo case but for Timestamp messages (RFC 792 Timestamp Request/Reply MUST)
approach:
[Objective]
Like Echo (ICMPV4_TYPE_09), Timestamp Replies must carry back the same identifier and sequence so the requester can correlate them to outstanding Requests.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester → DUT: ICMP Timestamp Request with chosen identifier and sequence

2. Observation (3 s window):
   • DUT → Tester: ICMP Timestamp Reply
      - identifier == Request's identifier   ← key check 1
      - sequence   == Request's sequence     ← key check 2

[Pass condition]
Both fields echoed correctly.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_id_mismatch — identifier in Reply did not match Request
• Fail_seq_mismatch — sequence in Reply did not match Request
• Fail_timeout — DUT did not emit a Reply within the window

verdicts.Pass: Reply echoed identifier and sequence — normal correlation
verdicts.Fail_id_mismatch: Reply identifier did not match Request
verdicts.Fail_seq_mismatch: Reply sequence did not match Request
verdicts.Fail_timeout: DUT did not emit a Reply within the window
